scope: 花纹提取页之外的功能检查与修复；现有花纹算法另作回归，未改算法。

fixes.defect: Placement review changed parent fingerprints without rebasing previously valid inferred descendants. Withdrawing review incorrectly produced STALE_MARKING and blocked final lock.
fixes.reproduction: Actual unwrap + automatic head placement + exact-symmetry inference; pre-fix test observed stale set size 1 when geometry unchanged.
fixes.change: Capture previously non-stale inference dependents before mutation; update only their parent fingerprints atomically after review. Already stale dependencies remain stale.
verified: Withdrawal reports AUTOMATIC_PLACEMENT_REVIEW without geometry staleness
Final lock approves parent and inferred markings
Previously stale source fingerprints are not blessed

fixes.defect: A clear confirmation opened on model A persisted through retained MappingPage when activating B, permitting the previous confirmation to clear B.
fixes.change: Reset confirmation when project/model context changes.
fixes.reproduction: Production Vue component fixture pre-fix failed expected confirmation count 0 vs actual 1 after swapping A to B.

fixes.defect: A selected inference source survived model switch/source deletion, enabling submission with an unavailable marking ID.
fixes.change: Derive current-model inference sources, clear invalid/context-switched selection, and refuse unavailable IDs before submitting.
verified: Deleting selected source disables inference while other sources remain

reproduction: 已有500 mm幅宽和9 mm片间距的保存排料
重新打开项目/制版排料页
旧实现表单固定1500 mm/5 mm，重算改变保存约束
fixes.resolution: 按项目ID和保存参数内容载入独立表单副本；无保存布局恢复默认。无关Session刷新不覆盖未提交草稿。
assertions: 实际方案变化及撤销/重做重新载入
无排料和切换项目恢复默认

reproduction: 未提交地修改X/Y/角度/锁定
同内容Session替换使旧watch(placement)按对象身份触发，清掉草稿
fixes.resolution: 按所选实例和placement实际内容变化同步，保留相同保存位置对应的草稿。
assertions: X70/Y80/180°/锁定草稿跨无关revision刷新保留

reproduction: 旧实现五个子页标签直接返回英文
fixes.resolution: 五个标签统一走localize；补素材/接ぎ目/配置词条。
assertions: 切回英语五标签精确匹配

fixes.trigger: Create/open/activate project while assistant is open
fixes.before: Assistant remained visible after successful project activation
fixes.fix: Success exits assistant and shows editor; cancelling open preserves assistant

fixes.trigger: Cancel project-file opening or fail local activation with active uncommitted draft
fixes.before: cancel() cleared the current draft before success was known
fixes.fix: Cancel editor interactions only after successful response

fixes.trigger: Failed project creation or Enter on empty name
fixes.before: Workflow moved to extraction before success; Enter could dispatch blank create
fixes.fix: Guard empty/busy create and update workflow only on success

fixes.trigger: Open recovery tab after initial revision 0 has left the ten-point retention window
fixes.before: Revision model stayed 0 and Restore button disabled despite displayed options
fixes.fix: Choose latest available point, retaining a valid selected revision

fixes.trigger: Click a diagnostic while viewing guide/model/other page
fixes.before: Only selectedId changed; user stayed on unrelated page
fixes.fix: Navigate/focus piece, seam or mapped marking according to issue rule ID and actual affected piece

fixes.trigger: Navigate workflow to a seam/material subtab with entity ID
fixes.fix: Update selectedId from navigation target only for piece subtab

fixes.trigger: Click completed/background task's piece name from another page
Project opens from assistant/home with storage notice followed by background refresh
fixes.before: Page scope transitions hid notice and subsequent quiet refresh could clear it; repeated notice could resurrect after dismissal
fixes.fix: Session-wide notice fallback with per-session dismissal and clearing on project switch

fixes.before: Only first page displayed; all RPCs reused ID 1
fixes.fix: Follow opaque cursors (including empty string), match unique request IDs in SSE, deduplicate tool names, reject repeating/non-string cursors, preserve protocol/session cleanup

fixes.trigger: Open a native file dialog or switch to another application while drawing a polygon
fixes.before: window blur cancelled all accumulated draft nodes
fixes.fix: Blur now stops the active pointer gesture while retaining already drawn nodes; explicit cancel and Escape still clear drafts

fixes.defect: 制版多边形、开放路径、孔洞保存失败后草稿丢失
fixes.resolution: 仅在成功提交后清除原草稿，拒绝误建已删除父裁片的孔洞，保留保存期间新开始的草稿。

fixes.defect: 制造预览中的裁片名称与布纹方向箭头重叠，深色区域文字难读
fixes.resolution: 分开自动名称与箭头的位置，为标注加入浅色描边；裁片几何、手动标注坐标与导出尺寸不变。
fixes.verified: 最终发布包通过7项预览验证，含文字边界不重叠、描边、缩放、分页和实际尺寸。

methods: 按功能清单分工审查界面、状态管理与持久化调用链。
用保存失败、失效父对象、切换模型和取消对话框等反例验证修复前后的行为。
通过单元测试覆盖状态边界，通过隐藏桌面测试验证实际点击、重启、撤销重做、导入导出与页面布局。
复核模型、裁切、拼接及制造截图；检查物理尺寸、标注边界与发布包内容一致性。

finalDisplayChangeValidation.note: 完整998项单元测试后仅调整预览标注显示；随后重新通过相关19项单元测试、类型检查、重复打包，以及最终发布包的全部68套桌面测试。

agents.integration: 主代理审核、补修、最终发布包回归与合并

modelViews.source: current source geometry and production SurfaceGpu.vue

modelWireframe.timingNote: Wall times include throttled animation-frame waits in the hidden host; GPU buffer build and paint CPU times are reported separately, not interaction FPS.

limits: AI提供商与MCP使用本地模拟服务验收，未消耗真实外部服务额度。
打印参数、分页和PDF尺寸已测，未向实体打印机发送作业。
全部桌面测试隐藏运行；组件测试使用真实生产Vue组件和隔离接口适配器，不冒充发布包端到端测试。
有限测试覆盖约定功能和已识别边界，不代表任意输入绝无缺陷。
花纹提取边缘算法不属本轮修复范围。
